api/api/SharedLibrary.Protocol.ProtocolM.summary: Class ProtocolMessageTypes Should be considered as an enum with protocol message types. Unfortunately, C# doesn't support enums with string values. Note: all the names are following ENTITY_ACTION_TYPE/VERSION convention. On "Command", "Request", and "Result": "Command": Most messages are commands. They are sent from client to server to mutate state and do not expect an explicit message response. The "response" is the updated player state. "Request": Messages sent from a requester that require an explicit, asynchronous message response. "Result": The message sent back in response to a "Request". Note: We use "Result" instead of "Response" because a Result represents a final state/outcome, whereas a Response is often viewed as just the act of replying. api/api/SharedLibrary.Protocol.ProtocolM.summary: Namespace SharedLibrary.Protocol.ProtocolMessages Classes BaseCheatProtocolMessage All the same as BaseProtocolMessage, but for messages which are considered to be cheats BaseProtocolMessage ProtocolMessageTypes Should be considered as an enum with protocol message types. Unfortunately, C# doesn't support enums with string values. Note: all the names are following ENTITY_ACTION_TYPE/VERSION convention. On "Command", "Request", and "Result": "Command": Most messages are commands. They are sent from client to server to mutate state and do not expect an explicit message response. The "response" is the updated player state. "Request": Messages sent from a requester that require an explicit, asynchronous message response. "Result": The message sent back in response to a "Request". Note: We use "Result" instead of "Response" because a Result represents a final state/outcome, whereas a Response is often viewed as just the act of replying. Interfaces IProtocolMessage Base interface for all protocol messages as they are sent over the network by a client. While not confirmed yet, it is likely that SleepagotchiBackend can receive a slightly extended version of these messages. I.e. those having additional fields.
